pub trait Ensures {
    fn ensures() -> bool;
}

pub struct Checker;

impl Ensures for Checker {
    fn ensures() -> bool {
        true
    }
}

impl Checker {
    pub fn inherent() -> bool {
        true
    }
}

pub fn helper() -> bool {
    true
}

fake_harness_macro::harness! {
    kani, VERIFY_CHECKER_SRC, {
        #[kani::proof]
        fn verify_checker() {
            assert!(Checker::ensures());
            helper();
        }
    }
}

fake_harness_macro::harness! {
    kani, ORDINARY_SRC, {
        fn ordinary_in_macro() {
            helper();
        }
    }
}

fake_harness_macro::harness! {
    kani, PATHS_SRC, {
        fn qualified_paths() {
            Checker::inherent();
            Ensures::ensures();
        }
    }
}
